item.title: [−1] Foreign investors sell ₹7,934 crore in the week to 16 October; October outflows top ₹52,100 crore
item.description:
October selling already exceeds September's ₹35,861 crore; 2026 outflows reach ₹3.12 lakh crore. A marginal buying day on Friday looks tactical, analysts say. Easing weekly pace, persistent trend.

Banks & NBFCs: mild headwind (−1) — Foreign selling in banks

Why it matters: Record annual outflows keep pressure on large banks and the rupee; the slower pace and a buying day hint at stabilisation if oil eases.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Sensex opens 120 points higher at 74,849 but slips to about 74,378 by midday on oil worries
item.description:
Nifty opened at 23,150.85 after gaining about 2.8% last week. State-run banks led early while private banks and IT lagged. Foreign investors turned buyers on Friday after 15 sessions of selling. Pausing after last week's rally.

Banks & NBFCs: mild headwind (−1) — Private banks lag

Why it matters: A pause after a strong week as crude near $108 and Hormuz tensions cap gains; a turn in foreign flows would support heavyweights if it lasts.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
